title: Case 008: Recipient needs a defined delivery slot rather than an all-day estimate

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A small appliance is booked on an all-day service. Scheduling must quote available timed slots and confirm the customer’s acceptance of any charge.
initial_request: I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request available timed slots from the scheduling team.

outcome: Scheduling confirms the customer's selected slot and any agreed service charge; delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Scheduling reports the accepted charge; the desk does not set prices or assert payment.

events.body: DL-008 currently has an all-day booking for 2026-02-10. Timed delivery may be available; only scheduling can quote live capacity and the upgrade charge.
I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.
Please quote available two-hour windows for DL-008 on 2026-02-10, with the total upgrade charge. Do not change the booking until Nemi accepts.

events.to: Nemi Thale, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: We can offer 2026-02-10, 12:00–14:00 UTC for a total upgrade charge of GBP 6.00. Reply in this verified booking thread to accept before 16:00 UTC today.
Nemi accepted the 12:00–14:00 slot and GBP 6.00 charge in the booking thread at 09:46 UTC. We confirmed DL-008 for 2026-02-10, 12:00–14:00 UTC at 09:48. Delivery remains pending.
